content: service method RequestUpdateSession [SWS_SM_91102] Upstream: RS_SM_00001 , RS_SM_00004 RequestUpdateSession () Has to be called by Update And Configuration Management once it has to start interaction with State Management. State Management might decline this request when machine is not in a state to be updated.
